title: Scope Control
description: Use when scope drift is likely. Covers no unapproved workarounds and no silent narrowing/substitution when requirements appear difficult.

requirements.statement: Do not satisfy the task by adding fake data, disabling checks, bypassing official workflows, or documenting a manual workaround unless the operator explicitly authorizes that scope change.
If a requirement appears impossible or unsafe, stop with proof and ask for an owner decision; do not silently narrow the task, substitute a different goal, or implement only the easiest subset.
